content.title: Registered Geometry Match | Material Credit Bridge and Master Title
content.summary: Establish stable planar registration points and one color anchor, reveal an original credit through a physical tool action, then match the same geometry into a different material surface for a second credit. Reuse the color anchor around one original motif object, transform the material once, fill the frame and hold an original master title.

quick_start.input_format: at least three stable planar geometry intersections and one color anchor + physical tool action reveals one original credit + exact screen-coordinate match into a different material surface + light or shadow reveals a second credit + color anchor receives one original motif object and transforms once + transformed material fills the frame and holds an original master title
quick_start.recommended_input: Ivory topographic contours and an amber survey dot guide a steel mapping stylus credit, match into a perforated observatory acoustic wall for a second credit, then an original brass tuning fork enters an amber ceramic disk that splits into the master title NORTH ARRAY.
required_anchors: Establish at least three stable geometry intersections and one color anchor before the first credit.
Reveal one short original credit through a tool action while preserving the geometry.
Return the color anchor around one original motif object and perform one tactile transformation.
Fill the frame with the transformed material and hold one large original master title.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish stable planar registration points and one color anchor, reveal an original credit through a physical tool action, then match the same geometry into a different material surface for a second credit. Reuse the color anchor around one original motif object, transform the material once, fill the frame and hold an original master title.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish an original planar geometry with at least three stable registration intersections and one replaceable color anchor. Let one tool action reveal a short original credit without losing the geometry, then match the same intersections into a materially different physical surface at the exact screen coordinates and reveal a second credit through light or shadow. Reintroduce the color anchor around one original motif object, cause one tactile material transformation and let that material fill the frame before resolving a large original master title. The reusable mechanism is registered geometry, material match cut, motif consolidation and physical-to-flat title closure—not the source maze, paper, pen, perforated wall, key, wax seal, names, title, red-black palette, exact typography, hands, composition, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish at least three stable geometry intersections and one color anchor before the first credit.
invariants.purpose: Creates measurable registration points for the later material match.
invariants.ablation_failure: A loose pattern cannot support a convincing cross-material join.

invariants.rule: Reveal one short original credit through a tool action while preserving the geometry.
invariants.purpose: Binds typography to physical cause instead of overlaying unrelated text.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the carrier disappears, the credit cannot hand off to the next surface.

invariants.rule: Match the same intersections into a materially different surface at exact screen coordinates.
invariants.purpose: Makes two independently generated segments read as one continuous title system.
invariants.ablation_failure: Approximate framing produces a visible jump instead of a designed seam.

invariants.rule: Return the color anchor around one original motif object and perform one tactile transformation.
invariants.purpose: Consolidates the earlier graphic clues into a terminal physical event.
invariants.ablation_failure: A new unrelated motif makes the final title feel detached.

invariants.rule: Fill the frame with the transformed material and hold one large original master title.
invariants.purpose: Converts physical motion into a readable final lockup.
invariants.ablation_failure: Continuing action after the title prevents the sequence from resolving.

slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source maze-like black grid, white paper texture, red circle and exact registration pattern
the source fountain pen, writing path, perforated wall, moving shadow and exact credit layouts
the source brass key, red wax seal, hands, crack shape and material transition
the source names, THE DEAD DROP title, fonts, kerning, red-black-white palette and title timing
the source creator identity, MiniMax H3 claim, watermark, prompt-below claim and branding
